data.name: Rijaalat
data.gender_notes: Rijaalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Those who embark on a journey or travel. The name Rijaalat carries the meaning “Travelers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rijaalat usually hope their child will grow to embody travelers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rijaalat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Travelers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rijaalat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رجالات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من رجال، يعني الرجولة والشجاعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رجالات مشتق من كلمة رجال، والتي تعني الرجولة والشجاعة في اللغة العربية. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بصفات القوة والشجاعة التي يرمز إليها الرجال في الإسلام. كما أن الاسم يحمل دلالات تاريخية في التراث الإسلامي، حيث كان الرجال يعرفون بكرمهم وشجاعتهم.

in_urdu.name: رجالات
in_urdu.meaning: رجولیت اور شجاعت کا ایک نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام رجالات عربی زبان کی کلمہ 'رجال' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رجولیت اور شجاعت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں شجاعت اور مردانگی کی صفات سے وابستہ ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں، یہ نام مردانگی اور عزت کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिजालात
in_hindi.meaning: पुरुषत्व और बहादुरी का एक नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रिजालात अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'रिजाल' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पुरुषत्व और बहादुरी। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहादुरी और वीरता के गुणों से जुड़ा हुआ है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पुरुषत्व और सम्मान के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: رجالاټ
in_pashto.meaning: د نارینه توب او زړورتیا یو نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رجالاټ نوم د عربي کلمې 'رجال' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده نارینه توب او زړورتیا. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دودیزو ارزښو کې د زړورتیا او سړيتوب سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Rijaalat
in_english.meaning: A name symbolizing manliness and bravery
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rijaalat is derived from the Arabic root 'R-J-L', which signifies manliness, bravery, and chivalry. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the qualities of courage and strength. Historically, the term 'Rijal' referred to noble and brave men in Islamic societies. The name Rijaalat embodies these virtues, reflecting a personality that is valorous, chivalrous, and strong-willed. Across Muslim cultures, this name is chosen for its positive connotations and traditional significance.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رجالاټ

data.cultural_impact: The term "Rijaalat" reflects a sense of movement, adventure, and exploration. In many ways, it embodies the spirit of embracing new experiences and expanding our horizons. In Islamic history, the concept of Rijaalat has been linked to the concept of Hijra, which refers to the migration of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his followers from Mecca to Medina. This momentous journey marked a turning point in Islamic history and set the foundation for the Muslim community as we know it today. The word Rijaalat can inspire a sense of unity among Muslims, as it reflects the shared history and experiences of the global Muslim community, which continues to travel and pursue new opportunities in various parts of the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the term "Rijaalat" can be seen as a metaphor for the spiritual journey that every individual undertakes in life. Like the physical journey of the Prophet Muhammad and his followers, the spiritual journey involves leaving behind the comforts and familiarities of one's old ways and venturing into new territory, seeking knowledge, guidance, and closeness to Allah. The word Rijaalat reminds us to remain steadfast in our faith and to continue seeking knowledge and growth, even in the face of challenges and obstacles. Ultimately, the spiritual journey is one that leads to self-discovery, inner peace, and closeness to Allah, making the term Rijaalat a powerful reminder of the transformative potential of spiritual growth and adventure.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Travelers" symbolizes Those who embark on a journey or travel. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rijaalat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of travelers.
